title: GTA Online: The Kortz Center Heist

features.desc: Multi-stage art robbery at Kortz Center gallery with multiple approaches and escapes.
Art Studio in mansions as heist planning room and board.
Prep missions leading to finale; solo or crew up to 4.
Stolen works can be sold for profit or displayed in owned mansions.
Update vehicles with Missile Lock-On Jammer upgrade availability.
Warp points, CCTV, new actors/props/interiors and stealth outfit logic.
